name: OpenClaw
summary: Open-source personal AI assistant framework: a local gateway control plane connecting AI models to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, and iMessage, with tools, skills, MCP, scheduling, and optional sandboxed execution — built for a single operator who owns their data.

agent-runtime.note: Gateway-managed sessions running AI-driven workflows with tools and skills.

orchestration.note: Scheduling for unattended automations; no declarative DAG/workflow engine.

knowledge-memory.note: Session and contextual memory managed by the gateway across channels.

tools-integration.note: Tools, skills, plugins, and MCP integrations distributed through ClawHub.

identity-governance.note: Pairing controls and access management for a single operator — not multi-tenant IAM, policies, quotas, or approvals.

observability.note: No structured trace, usage, or audit model beyond gateway session logs.

data-secrets.note: No managed file storage or encrypted secrets store.

evaluation.note: No built-in datasets, scorers, or eval runs.

channels.note: First-class gateways for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and iMessage — its headline feature.

code-execution.note: Optional isolated (sandboxed) execution environments for tool runs.
